text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report presents the results of staff's investigation on a traffic study conducted at the intersection of Delma Drive and Mitcham Drive to determine the feasibility for all-way stop controls. Although the technical warrants are not fully met, staff recommend the installation of an all-way stop control at the intersection of Delma Drive and Mitcham Drive. This would address the issue of the continued occurrence of angled type collisions at this intersection.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of Delma Drive and Mitcham Drive.
